name: evaporative_condenser_catalogue
title: Evaporative condenser with catalogue data (BAC VXC) and operating checks
summary: Evaporative condenser of the Laborelec 2002 toolkit: heat flow from the condensing ammonia to the air/spray water computed with the fictitious-fluid theory on the air side and a condensing resistance on the refrigerant side; nominal parameters from a BAC VXC catalogue lookup table, check procedures for effectiveness, manufacturer limits, fooling factor and subcooling.

authors: Felipe Trebilcock (ULiege Thermodynamics Lab, Dec 2002, for Laborelec)
origin.course: Laborelec toolkit 2002 (evaporative equipment), EES Diagram-Window simulation model; catalogue table condenserdata.LKT (candidate TM-0299)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution (67 records): 67 common variables, 21 differ above rtol = 0.001: 6 by the constant ammonia reference-state offset (derived differences 6.9e-04), 15 downstream of the humid-air property differences EES 6.596 vs CoolProp, max 4.27e-03 (W_su_cd), as in CSL-0290.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of Evaporative_condenser_simulation.EES (ees_variables.csv; M_dot_r, computed here but absent from the EES storage, and the 7 string variables excluded)
verification.notes: max_rel_diff excludes the 6 absolute-state variables carrying the ammonia reference-state offset (absolute h_r_ex_cd 2.96e-01, s_r_su_cp 7.76e-02); max over the 15 remaining differences 4.27e-03 (W_su_cd). 40+ algebraic results below 1e-03. Strings checked by eye in the .sol (messages empty).
